bootstrap_unit: Complete India 0.5-degree spatial unit with all 12 months
core_metrics_note: Core-only metrics are NaN when the input contains no core-eligible spatial units.
evaluation_scope: India-wide pooled geographic cross-validation over the spatial units in the Stage-06 feature table; each prediction retains its spatial-unit ID and held-out fold.
alpha_selection_policy: Validation fold selects alpha; model then refitted on all non-test regions
